title: Elliptic theory and dimension drop for operators with divergence-free form-bounded drifts in one-sided chord-arc domains
summary: We develop a boundary value and potential theory for elliptic operators \[ L=-\Div(A\nabla)+\B\cdot\nabla \] with form-bounded drift in one-sided chord-arc domains. Assuming that the positive part of $\Div\B$ has sufficiently small form bound, we establish local regularity estimates and solvability of the Dirichlet problem, and construct the associated harmonic measure. Under the additional assumption $\Div\B\le0$, we construct a Green's function and prove pointwise and gradient estimates.
